Class PlacementPhase

java.lang.Object
model.phaseHandlers.PlacementPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseHandler, GameCommandVisitor
public class PlacementPhase extends Object implements GamePhaseHandler
Orchestrates the sequential totem placement phase, where players select their desired offer tiles for the upcoming round based on the established turn order.

This handler manages an internal stateful iteration over the players, ensuring strict adherence to the round's sequence. Its lifecycle encompasses:

  1. Initialization: Snapshotting the current turn order and cueing the first active player.
  2. Command Processing: Intercepting PlaceTotemCommands via double-dispatch, rigorously validating turn authorization, tile existence, and tile availability.
  3. Fault Tolerance: Automatically skipping the turns of disconnected players to prevent game deadlocks, ensuring their totems are handled via a fallback mechanism.
  4. State Transition: Automatically advancing the global game state to the ActionPhase once all valid totems have been successfully placed on the board.

    • onEnter

      public void onEnter()
      Bootstraps the phase by loading the current turn order and setting the execution pointer to the first player.

      If the first player in the sequence is detected as disconnected upon entry, the system immediately delegates to the turn-advancement logic to maintain flow.

      Specified by:
      onEnter in interface GamePhaseHandler

    • visit

      public void visit(PlaceTotemCommand cmd) throws Exception
      Intercepts and processes a client's request to place their totem on a specific tile.

      This method acts as a strict validator before allowing model mutation. It ensures the command originates from the active player and targets a valid, unoccupied tile. Upon successful validation, it delegates the physical placement to the Board and advances the internal turn sequence.

      Specified by:
      visit in interface GameCommandVisitor
      Specified by:
      visit in interface GamePhaseHandler
      Parameters:
      cmd - the payload containing the player's identity and their targeted tile ID.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the targeted tile does not exist, if the tile is already occupied, or if the requesting player is not the current active player.
      Exception - if an unexpected error occurs during board mutation.

    • advanceTurn

      private void advanceTurn()
      Progresses the state to the next available player in the turn order.

      This method encapsulates the iteration logic, automatically skipping over any disconnected players and moving their totem to first free slot from the bottom. When the sequence is exhausted (all players processed), it executes a cleanup routine for disconnected players (freeing their slots and triggering fallback effects) before permanently transitioning the game to the ActionPhase.
